name: bloom
description: Balances, payments, trades, and wallets for AI agents on EVM chains and Solana. Every transaction needs the user's passkey.

interface.longDescription: Bloom gives agents balances, payments, trades, and wallets on EVM chains and Solana through ordinary files. Agents stage actions; policy, the user's passkey approval, and key custody are enforced outside the agent. Installing the skill does not install Bloom or create a wallet.
